title: Ice Maker Function Error
shortDescription: Samsung ice maker has experienced a motor or harvest failure.
fullDescription:
The 39 E code on Samsung refrigerators indicates the ice maker motor did not complete a harvest cycle in the expected time. This often stems from a frozen ice mold, jammed cubes, or ejector motor failure.

A forced defrost and manual reset typically clears temporary issues. Persistent errors point to a hardware fault.

fixSteps.title: Clear ice
fixSteps.instruction: Remove ice bucket and break up any ice sheets or clumps.

fixSteps.title: Forced defrost
fixSteps.instruction: Enter forced defrost mode per service manual to clear frost.

fixSteps.title: Replace ice maker
fixSteps.instruction: Remove mounting screws and swap the ice maker assembly.

whenToCallPro: If replacing the ice maker does not resolve the error.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung fridge 39 E ice maker error

faq.a: Sometimes. Hold Energy Saver and Lighting buttons for 10 seconds for reset.

title: Ice Maker Sensor Error
shortDescription: Ice maker temperature sensor reading out of range.
fullDescription:
Code 40 E indicates the thermistor inside the ice maker compartment is reporting abnormal values. The control board depends on this sensor to trigger harvest cycles.

Replacing the ice maker assembly (which includes the sensor) usually resolves the issue.

fixSteps.title: Inspect harness
fixSteps.instruction: Check sensor connections behind the ice maker.

fixSteps.title: Replace ice maker
fixSteps.instruction: Install a new ice maker assembly that includes the thermistor.

whenToCallPro: If sensor replacement does not clear the code.
videoSearchQuery: Samsung 40 E ice maker sensor error

faq.q: Can I replace just the sensor?
faq.a: In most Samsung models the sensor is integral to the assembly and not separately sold.

title: Ice Room Fan Error
shortDescription: Ice room fan not reaching target speed.
fullDescription:
41 E is triggered when the dedicated ice room fan motor (found on French door models) fails to spin properly. Without adequate airflow, ice cannot freeze in the mold.

Check for frost buildup or a failed fan motor.

fixSteps.title: Forced defrost
fixSteps.instruction: Run forced defrost to melt frost around the fan.

fixSteps.title: Replace fan motor
fixSteps.instruction: Remove ice room panel and install new fan motor.

whenToCallPro: If defrost does not clear and motor replacement seems intimidating.

faq.a: A failing door gasket or auto close issue can let humid air into the ice compartment.

title: Ice Maker Auto Mode Disabled
shortDescription: Ice maker auto cycle has been turned off by protective logic.
fullDescription:
Samsung displays 42 E when the control board disables automatic ice making after repeated cycle faults. Manual intervention is required to restart.

Resetting and ensuring no mechanical obstruction typically restores function.

fixSteps.title: Reset fridge
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Energy Saver + Lighting for 10 seconds to reset.

fixSteps.title: Enable ice maker
fixSteps.instruction: Turn Ice Maker On from control panel.

faq.a: Press and hold the test button on the ice maker for 3-10 seconds.

title: Fridge Fan Error
shortDescription: Main refrigerator fan failure affecting cooling.
fullDescription:
Code 23 E points to the refrigerator compartment fan. Poor circulation limits ice making and causes warm food areas.

Defrost first, then check the fan motor electrically.

fixSteps.title: Defrost fridge
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug for 8 hours to clear ice.

fixSteps.title: Replace fan
fixSteps.instruction: Access rear panel and swap the fan motor.

whenToCallPro: If you cannot safely disassemble the rear evaporator cover.

faq.a: Yes if fridge warms above 40F for 4+ hours - move perishables.

title: Display Reset Required
fullDescription:
After a power glitch, the Samsung display can show 88 88, indicating the control board is stuck. Power cycling the unit usually restores normal operation, including ice maker functions.

If it persists, inspect the main control board.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug fridge for 10 minutes, then plug back in.

whenToCallPro: If power cycle does not clear, board replacement may be needed.

faq.a: Yes, usually within 12-24 hours after reset.

title: Water Filter Replacement
shortDescription: Samsung water filter is due for replacement.
fullDescription:
Samsung uses filter models like DA29-00020B. After 6 months, the indicator turns red and water flow can be reduced.

Replace and reset the indicator using the Ice/Water button.

fixSteps.title: Swap filter
fixSteps.instruction: Twist old filter out, insert new, rotate to lock.

fixSteps.title: Reset indicator
fixSteps.instruction: Hold Ice Type + Child Lock for 3 seconds to reset.

faq.a: Every 6 months or 300 gallons, whichever comes first.

title: Refrigerator Fan Error
shortDescription: Second refrigerator fan issue in some dual-fan models.
fullDescription:
22 E represents refrigerator section fan error on certain Samsung models. Ice maker performance degrades when fridge temperature rises.

Defrost and inspect the fan.

fixSteps.title: Inspect fan
fixSteps.instruction: Open rear panel and verify fan spins freely.

whenToCallPro: If defrost insufficient and motor replacement needed.

faq.a: Related but on a different fan; both indicate fridge cooling issues.

title: Ice Bucket Motor Error
fullDescription:
83 E indicates failure in the auger motor that dispenses ice from the bucket. The dispenser will not deliver ice until repaired.

Check for jammed ice before replacing the motor.

fixSteps.title: Empty bucket
fixSteps.instruction: Remove bucket and break up clumped ice.

fixSteps.title: Replace auger
fixSteps.instruction: Install new auger motor assembly if motor fails test.

whenToCallPro: If auger motor replacement is beyond comfort level.

faq.a: No, only dispensing; ice continues to be made but cannot be dispensed.

title: Freezer Defrost Error
shortDescription: Freezer defrost heater or sensor failure.
fullDescription:
14 E indicates the freezer defrost system did not operate correctly. Ice will accumulate and eventually block fans and the ice maker.

Inspect the defrost heater, thermostat, and sensor.

fixSteps.title: Test heater
fixSteps.instruction: Measure resistance across defrost heater; replace if open.

fixSteps.title: Replace sensor
fixSteps.instruction: Install new defrost sensor and reseat harness.

whenToCallPro: For most users - evaporator disassembly is involved.

faq.a: Short term yes, but frost will build quickly and compromise cooling.
